name: feature-flag-table
title: Feature flag table
description: Flags with a switch, key, environments and a rollout slider (percent of users) that dims while off. Searchable, controlled.
htmlExample: <bef-feature-flag-table class="w-[44rem] max-w-full" :flags='[{"key":"new-checkout","name":"New checkout","description":"One-page checkout","enabled":true,"rollout":25,"environments":["Production","Staging"],"owner":"Payments"},{"key":"ai-search","name":"AI search","description":"Semantic results","enabled":true,"rollout":100,"environments":["Staging"],"owner":"Search"},{"key":"dark-mode","name":"Dark mode","enabled":false,"rollout":0,"environments":["Production"],"owner":"Design"},{"key":"bulk-export","name":"Bulk export","description":"CSV of everything","enabled":true,"rollout":50,"environments":["Production"],"owner":"Data"}]' emit="change"></bef-feature-flag-table>
